title: Demonstration of Co-Packaged Optics Assembly for Fiber-Based Optical Interconnect
notes: 65x65 mm MCP: FPGA, 2 data converters, 3 EIC-PIC stacks on open-cavity EMIB substrate, butt-coupled FAUs; assembly flow and delamination yield; few dimensions.

title: Process Integration of Photonic Interposer for Chiplet-based 3D Systems
notes: 200 mm SOI SiPho interposer: TSV-middle 12x100 um, 4-level AlCu BEOL, Cu/Ni/Au u-pillars, backside RDL, thermal cavities, SnAg bumps. Full system still in fabrication.

title: Technology Enhancements on Focos-Bridge for Emerging Trends in High-Performance Computing (HPC) and Artificial Intelligence (AI)
notes: 85x85 mm MCM: 2 FO modules (~1.8x reticle, ~1500 mm2), each 1 ASIC + 4 HBM3 + 4 TSV bridges + 10 IPD; MR vs TCB joints; simulated bridge warpage and R/L.

title: Panel Level Fine Patterning RDL Interposer Package
notes: Panel-level chip-last 6-layer RDL interposer (4.3x reticle, 12 HBM + 2 logic + 2 chiplets) on organic carrier; L/S 2/2 um, UBM undulation DOE, smile warpage 3-4 mm. C4 not yet formed.

title: A Study About Bonding Properties with Multilayer Porous Structures for Fine Pitch Interconnection
notes: Nanoporous Cu (NP-Cu) bumps capped by Ni, Ag, Ni/Ag or SnAg plating; seed-etch resistance, compression, shear, phi 7 um bonding, phi 75 um 8x8 daisy chain. Org name printed 'Corporration' (sic).
